इत्थं ind. Thus, so, in this
manner; इत्थं रतेः किमपि भूतमदृश्यरूपं

.
--Comp.
--कारं ind. in this
manner.
--भूत a. {1} so circumstanced,
being in this state, being thus;
˚आख्याने

. {2} true or faithful (as a
story).
--भावः being thus endowed,
having these qualities.
--विध a. {1} of
such kind. {2} endowed with such
qualities.
इत्थशालः N. of the third Yoga.

In this
manner, thus.
--2 A particle of
affirmation used to lay stress on a
following word, indeed.
--3 Truly, really.
˚धी a. performing such or true
works.
इत्थात् ind. Thus, in this way.
